title: Pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2
text: Single cells donor statistically independent: share genetic background, batch effects, ambient RNA. Treating cell independent observation regression inflates effective sample size distorts p-values. common, principled remedy pseudobulk: sum donor’s cells within group (e.g. cluster) produce per-donor count vector, run count-based regression like DESeq2::DESeq donors. unit replication becomes donor, cell. presto provides: collapse_counts() — fast collapse cell--gene count matrix pseudobulks defined one metadata columns. pseudobulk_deseq2() — run DESeq2 across resulting pseudobulks one-vs-, pairwise, within-group design. top_markers_dds() — extract top features per group result.

title: Pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2
text: use colon-tissue CD8 T-cell dataset Thomas et al. Nat. Med. 2024 (GSE206299). 27 donors, 9 cell clusters, 25,341 cells. crosstab confirms donors contribute cells clusters — good news pseudobulk, since clusters represented donors low statistical power.

title: Pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2
text: collapse_counts() sums columns count matrix according one metadata columns. collapse (donor, cluster), drop (donor, cluster) pair fewer 10 cells, keep cell count N can inspect came . collapse (donor, cluster, case) instead just (donor, cluster) case constant within donor — including now makes available within-cluster contrast Step 4. cc$counts_mat now 28,165-gene × 204-pseudobulk matrix. column one (donor, cluster) sample; cc$meta_data matching data.frame pseudobulk identities.
code: md <- data.frame(     donor   = as.character(d$obs$donor),     cluster = as.character(d$obs$cluster),     case    = as.character(d$obs$case),     stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) cc <- collapse_counts(     d$counts, md, c("donor", "cluster", "case"),     min_cells_per_group = 10,     keep_n = TRUE ) dim(cc$counts_mat) #> [1] 28165   204 head(cc$meta_data) #>   donor cluster    case   N #> 1  MC_1       5 Control  80 #> 2  MC_1       3 Control  46 #> 3  MC_1       4 Control 100 #> 4  MC_1       1 Control 323 #> 5  MC_1       6 Control  51 #> 6  MC_1       2 Control 110 table(cc$meta_data$cluster) #>  #>  1  2  3  4  5  6  7  8  9  #> 27 27 26 27 25 23 26 18  5

title: Pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2
text: pseudobulk_deseq2() mode = "one_vs_all" tests cluster union others. collapse_background = FALSE keep background pseudobulk observation; setting TRUE collapses background pseudobulks per donor first, preferable donors unbalanced across clusters. first variable formula contrast variable. meta_data contain pseudobulk identifying variables used formula. Result columns come straight DESeq2::results(), prepended group identifier:
code: md_dge <- cc$meta_data[, "cluster", drop = FALSE] res <- pseudobulk_deseq2(     ~cluster, md_dge, cc$counts_mat,     verbose = FALSE,     min_counts_per_sample = 10,     present_in_min_samples = 5,     collapse_background = FALSE,     mode = "one_vs_all" ) head(res) #>   group                  feature baseMean log2FoldChange lfcSE stat   pvalue #> 1     1      ENSG00000128951|DUT    42.72           1.35 0.108 12.5 6.67e-36 #> 2     1     ENSG00000105486|LIG1     4.18           1.69 0.138 12.2 2.49e-34 #> 3     1 ENSG00000134291|TMEM106C    13.14           1.67 0.138 12.1 7.54e-34 #> 4     1    ENSG00000188486|H2AFX    10.49           1.86 0.155 12.0 2.92e-33 #> 5     1     ENSG00000120802|TMPO    14.95           1.34 0.113 11.9 1.13e-32 #> 6     1     ENSG00000163535|SGO2     2.85           2.17 0.186 11.7 1.50e-31 #>       padj #> 1 6.69e-32 #> 2 1.25e-30 #> 3 2.52e-30 #> 4 7.33e-30 #> 5 2.27e-29 #> 6 2.50e-28

title: Pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2
text: mode = "pairwise" tests cluster cluster individually, returning long-form table group1 group2 columns. conservative one-vs-true marker differentiate cluster every cluster, just average background. cost grows quickly — N clusters means N × (N−1) directional DESeq2 fits — ’s worth subsetting levels care first. contrast clusters 1, 2, 3: summarize_dge_pairs() collapses directional pairs one row per (group, gene). Pass "min" keep gene’s worst comparison (conservative effect, useful high-confidence markers) "max" best.

title: Pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2
text: interesting biological question “defines cluster” “cluster, genes change irColitis cases healthy controls?”. mode = "within" answers . first variable formula split variable (cluster), second contrast variable (case). Within level split variable, DESeq2 fits inner formula (~case). Top genes upregulated cases per cluster: Cluster-1 cases -regulate NCF1, PRNP, TXNIP — interferon-response oxidative-stress genes consistent inflamed tissue.
code: md_w <- cc$meta_data[, c("cluster", "case")]  res_w <- pseudobulk_deseq2(     ~cluster + case, md_w, cc$counts_mat,     verbose = FALSE,     min_counts_per_sample = 10,     present_in_min_samples = 5,     mode = "within" ) head(res_w) #>   group                   feature baseMean log2FoldChange lfcSE stat   pvalue #> 1     1      ENSG00000158517|NCF1    73.62           1.45 0.194 7.50 6.58e-14 #> 2     1      ENSG00000171867|PRNP    30.67           1.80 0.242 7.45 9.11e-14 #> 3     1     ENSG00000162496|DHRS3     8.52           2.62 0.386 6.77 1.29e-11 #> 4     1      ENSG00000185101|ANO9    10.32           1.76 0.261 6.75 1.52e-11 #> 5     1     ENSG00000265972|TXNIP   202.85           1.34 0.199 6.74 1.60e-11 #> 6     1 ENSG00000268804|LINC02132     9.84           2.78 0.414 6.72 1.78e-11 #>       padj #> 1 3.38e-11 #> 2 4.45e-11 #> 3 4.51e-09 #> 4 4.63e-09 #> 5 4.74e-09 #> 6 4.99e-09 top_markers_dds(res_w, n = 5, padj_max = 1e-4, lfc_min = 1) %>%     dplyr::mutate(across(-rank, ~ sub(".*\\|", "", .x))) #> # A tibble: 5 × 9 #>    rank `1`   `2`    `3`   `4`   `5`    `6`    `7`     `8`    #>   <int> <chr> <chr>  <chr> <chr> <chr>  <chr>  <chr>   <chr>  #> 1     1 NCF1  SPINK2 LAIR1 DHRS7 SPINK2 GNPTAB LDLRAD4 RPS12  #> 2     2 PRNP  SORBS3 NA    CA10  NA     DHRS7  NA      RPL30  #> 3     3 DHRS3 KIFC3  NA    NCF1  NA     TXNIP  NA      EEF1B2 #> 4     4 ANO9  GNPTAB NA    KIFC3 NA     FCER1G NA      MT-ND3 #> 5     5 TXNIP CALHM6 NA    MYBL1 NA     TGFBR1 NA      NA

title: Pseudobulk differential expression with DESeq2
text: Filter low-count genes early. min_counts_per_sample present_in_min_samples applied fitting; tighter filters speed DESeq2 step substantially. Always include batch / channel covariates possible. Add formula contrast variable (e.g. ~cluster + channel) design supports . collapse_background = TRUE (mode = "one_vs_all") can stabilize results donor representation uneven across clusters. mode = "within" supports 2-level ordinal contrasts. Two-level contrasts (factor character) get Wald test level-vs-reference coefficient. Three levels integer-encoded treated ordinal trend.
